_readme: Bromic installations found on the open web (12 Nov 2026), outside Bromic's own case-study pages. Every entry names its sources; most are snippets or third-party pages and must be confirmed with the customer before use. Images owned by others are listed, never copied. Every find is written up: full drafts CSW-*, partial case studies CSP-* (content/case-studies/web/). Pass two: 12 Nov 2026.

installs.heated_area_or_seats: upper deck dining area
installs.installer: StruXure Utah (pergola dealer; the post says the company will install the heaters)
installs.year: 2023 (post dated 13 Oct 2023; described as planned work)
installs.story: A Park City tavern whose upper deck had only been usable in warm months. StruXure Utah posted that it would add a StruXure pergola with Bromic heaters, MistAmerica misting, AspectLED dimmable lighting and Progressive MagnaTrack vinyl screens, so the screens hold the heat in and block wind while keeping the mountain view. The post describes the plan; it does not confirm the work was finished.
installs.case_study_value: A mountain-resort town with cold winters, plus a pergola-partner channel (StruXure), which suits a 'designed from the start' story. First confirm the install was finished and which products were used, with StruXure Utah or the venue.

sources.says: Photo post (13 Oct 2023) saying the Boneyard Saloon upper deck will get Bromic heaters together with vinyl wind screens, misting and lighting, to make the deck usable in colder weather. The model and the number of heaters are not given.

images.owner: StruXure Utah

installs.venue: The Luna (Wilmington Parade of Homes entry), Airlie at Wrightsville Sound
installs.heated_area_or_seats: porch overlooking the pool
installs.year: 2026 (page and images dated 2026; parade year not stated)
installs.story: A fully custom coastal home built by Hardison Building for the Wilmington Parade of Homes, with a gunite pool, hot tub, exotic-wood porch ceilings and an outdoor kitchen with Wolf appliances. The feature list names custom recessed Bromic heaters on the porch that overlooks the pool. The home won a Gold award for Best Outdoor Living.

installs.case_study_value: An award-winning parade home in a humid coastal Southeast market, with a named builder: a strong builder-channel story about recessed heat designed in from the start. Coastal site: worth checking whether Marine-grade units were used.

sources.says: Feature list includes custom recessed Bromic heaters on the porch overlooking the pool; builder Hardison Building; Gold for Best Outdoor Living.

installs.products: Bromic Platinum Electric heater; Bromic Tungsten wall-mounted heaters (matte black)
installs.heated_area_or_seats: outdoor living, dining and grilling zones; grilling zone about 75 sq ft
installs.story: A showhome in Juneau's temperate rainforest with its outdoor space split into living, dining and grilling zones. The open grilling zone of about 75 sq ft took a Platinum Electric heater for durability, and matte-black wall-mounted Tungsten heaters were chosen to read as part of the architecture. The clients picked electric over propane or natural gas; the designer calls outdoor heat close to a necessity in Alaska.
installs.confidence: high (source names Bromic at this venue explicitly)
installs.case_study_value: The coldest-climate US residential example found, with a named designer and zone-by-zone product choices. Note that it is Bromic-sponsored content, so check it is not already held as an internal case study.
